id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

bodyMessage.description: The text messages to show alongside the file upload input.

multiSelect.description: The boolean that specify whether the file uploader takes multiple files or not.

fileSizeLimit.description: The limit of all files combined in bytes.

allowableFileExtensions.description: An array of extension strings that are acceptable.

rejectInvalidFiles.description:
Whether or not to reject files that don't end in one of the file extensions from allowableFileExtensions.
Will be ignored if text/txt, video/*, text/csv, etc. format is used for file extension.
Only used for instances where an invalid file can be selected due to https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=646941

totalFilesSize.description:
The aggregate size of all files in bytes.
This amount only considers the current instance of the UiSdlFileUpload component.

validFiles.description:
A {@link UiSdlFileUploadFileRef} data structure to store the valid file(s) from the most recent submission.
This will store an empty array `[]` or the valid file(s) from the most recent submission.
If a list of all valid and processed files is needed, use {@link UiSdlFileUpload#files}.

Example:
```
"validFiles": [
  {
    "name": "helloWorld.csv",
    "type": "text/csv"
  }
]
```

invalidSizeFiles.description:
A {@link UiSdlFileUploadFileRef} data structure to store all invalid size files.
If you submit a file that is larger than the {@link UiSdlFileUpload#fileSizeLimit},
it will be stored in this data structure.

Example:
```
"invalidSizeFiles": [
  {
    "name": "helloWorld.csv",
    "size": 4096,
    "type": "text/csv"
  },
  {
    "name": "goodbyeWorld.csv",
    "size": 8192,
    "type": "text/csv"
  }
]
```

cancelConfirmationModalId.description:
A reference to the modal that appears when the user leaves the UiSdlFileUpload parent component
when files have been selected.

duplicateFilesWarningModalId.description: A reference to the modal that appears when the user uploads files with the same name.

title: A UI component type that represents a file uploader.
name: UiSdlFileUpload
